listing.name: God of War: Ascension — gowa-pc (RichardFontoura) (RichardFontoura)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, menus, New Game and an input tutorial, but the first level runs too slowly. The project explicitly says it is not playable. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BCUS98232 disc with update 1.12.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s local source-build instructions and Tk launcher setup.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, menus, New Game and an input tutorial, but the first level runs too slowly. The project explicitly says it is not playable.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
